## Checklist
- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] New behaviour has a test in `tests/functional_test.py` (including failure / abuse cases for security features)
- [ ] `bandit -r panel -ll` shows nothing new
- [ ] Documentation updated (`docs/USER-GUIDE.md`, README, SECURITY.md if it affects security)
- [ ] No secrets, personal data or private hostnames in the change
